title: feat(platform-objects): exchange rates import from CSV through the generic import door

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoBvx33UvpFTTw3UFuQN9Tmg)_

Fixes #27190

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

domain:server#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyvv7cwzqLtsvHGmby

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 实测确认通用异步导入（`sys_import_job`，`POST /data/sys_exchange_rate/import/jobs`）原样就能导汇率 CSV，不需要新导入器；本 PR 补一条端到端钉住测试，打开汇率列表页的「导入」按钮（`userActions: { import: true }`），并在多币种文档里加一段说明。
- **为什么改：** 财务一年 12 行 × N 币种要一次导完；接口早就能导，但汇率表属 `system-data`，列表页的导入入口默认关着，原测试写明「等 #27190 证明后再开」。
- **风险与回滚：** 低。只是一处对象声明加一行，谁能导入仍由原来的写权限（组织管理员）决定；回滚即删这一行。
- **先看：** `packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-exchange-rate.object.ts`（`userActions` 一行）、`packages/rest/src/import-exchange-rate-csv.test.ts`、`content/docs/data-modeling/currency.mdx`。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/import-exchange-rate-csv.test.ts`，预期 3 条全过：三行 CSV 全部落库、`source` 列照写、重复 (币种, 日期) 那一行被拒而同文件其余行照常落库。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`sys_exchange_rate` opts in to CSV import** (`packages/platform-objects`): `userActions: { import: true }`. `system-data` keeps import off by default; this object turns it on because the generic door serves it end to end (measured below). Authorization is unchanged: the import door asks the same write grant as New and Edit, which `organization_admin` holds and `member_default` does not. The declaration test now pins `import: true` (its old title said "no CSV import until #27190 proves it").
- **Pin test** `packages/rest/src/import-exchange-rate-csv.test.ts`: the real `sys_exchange_rate` and `sys_import_job` on a real sqlite engine, driven through the async import routes:
  - three CSV lines land as three rows, the twelve-decimal rate intact, `source` at its default `manual`;
  - a `source` column reading `import` is written as given;
  - a line repeating a `(currency, effective_date)` already on file is refused for that row alone (`UNIQUE_VIOLATION`), the next line of the same file lands, and the stored rate is untouched.
- **Docs**: one paragraph under "The exchange rates" in `content/docs/data-modeling/currency.mdx`: the three columns, both doors, the per-row duplicate refusal, and the `source` column.
- **Changeset** `27190-exchange-rate-csv-import.md` (`@objectstack/platform-objects` patch).

No importer was added: the measurement found the generic one serves the table.

## Tests

<details><summary>Measurement on a fresh dev server (base 3ba52069, before any edit)</summary>

`pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh -p 38719`, signed in as the dev admin, `POST /api/v1/data/sys_exchange_rate/import/jobs` with `format: csv`:

- three lines (EUR 0.92 2026-01-01, JPY 149.123456789012 2026-01-01, GBP 0.79 2026-02-01): `201`, job `succeeded`, `created 3`, `errors 0`; the list read back all three with the JPY rate's twelve decimals, `source: manual`, and the organization id stamped.
- a second file repeating EUR 2026-01-01 plus a CHF line: job `succeeded`, `created 1`, `errors 1`; row 1 `UNIQUE_VIOLATION`, row 2 created.
- a file with a `source` column reading `import`: the row stored `source: import`.
- after the change (platform-objects rebuilt, server restarted): `/api/v1/meta/object/sys_exchange_rate` serves `userActions: { import: true }`, and the three-line import still answers `succeeded 3 0`.

</details>

<details><summary>Package suites and ablation</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test`: Test Files 356 passed (356), Tests 6846 passed, 332 skipped (at 3ce29739; the last commit only replaces a route lookup in the new test, re-run alone 3/3 at ff0eabcd).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: Test Files 104 passed (104), Tests 1474 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck`: exit 0 (rest at ff0eabcd, after fixing three TS18048 in the new test that `check:test-typecheck` caught).
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/platform-objects packages/rest`: exit 0.
- Ablation of the refusal pin: the unique key on `(currency, effective_date)` replaced by a plain index (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, platform-objects rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in 8 dist files). The duplicate-refusal case went red: expected `created 1, errors 1`, received `created 2, errors 0` (the duplicate landed); the other two cases stayed green. Restored (blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty), rebuilt, preflight `--absent` clean, 3/3 green.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Imported rows say `manual` unless the file says otherwise.** The `source` field's description reads "loaded from a file (import)", but the generic import writes the field's default, `manual`, when the CSV carries no `source` column; nothing in the import path stamps `import`. This PR documents the column and pins that it is honoured. Making the import stamp it by itself is a design choice beyond this card (an import-origin signal on the write context, or a shipped import mapping with a `constant` transform), so it goes to the seat as an open question, not into this diff. `sys_exchange_rate` has not been released yet (its changeset is still pending), so no shipped row carries the mislabel.
- The card's two-minute check ("导入一份 CSV 后列表页出现各行") needed the list page's Import button, which `system-data` kept off; the dispatch order expected a pin test and a docs line only, so turning the affordance on is a declared addition, one line, in its own commit.
- Not measured: the Console import wizard itself (the dev server ran without a built Console); the affordance reaching it is measured through `/meta`. A rank-and-file member's refusal at the door is unchanged authorization and was not re-measured.

## Verification

- `pnpm check:query-options-erasure`: exit 1, the new test grew the test surface 236 → 238 with two untyped engine-option casts; fixed in 3ce29739 by dropping the casts, re-run exit 0 (236, at the ceiling, none new).

The whole list is re-run on the final head ff0eabcd; its reconciliation is recorded in the card report.

</details>

The branch is 9 commits behind `main`; none of them touches a file this PR changes, so it was not merged before opening (CI builds the merge ref).
